title: From Abortion to Adoption: The Power of Redemption and Forgiveness
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful story of how God used a young person's testimony to change the course of a life. Listen as they recount the miraculous moment when a 16-year-old girl and her mother were persuaded to choose life for their unborn baby, and discover the life-changing impact of living out your faith in the midst of difficult conversations.
